points.K1: 连体服加手套，封住手腕

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验室缓冲间里，身边挂着防护服
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in a laboratory anteroom beside a rack of white protective coveralls, and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 今天在缓冲间，学穿防护。

shots.scene: 小研拿着样本转运箱，准备进实验室
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds a sealed sample transport box and walks toward the anteroom.
shots.narration: 小研今天要处理液体样本。

shots.scene: 阿杰跟在后面，只穿实验服就想往里走
shots.prompt_en: The young male student follows in only a lab coat and reaches for the inner door.
shots.narration: 阿杰说：我穿实验服就够了吧？

shots.scene: 小研拦住阿杰，指向墙上的空白规程
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stops him and points at a blank procedure poster with icons on the wall.
shots.narration: 小研说：先看规程，一步步穿。

shots.section_title: 连体服加手套，封住手腕
shots.scene: 小研穿上白色连体防护服，拉起兜帽
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student puts on a white disposable coverall and pulls up the hood.
shots.narration: 先穿一次性连体防护服，
overlay: 连体服加手套，封住手腕

shots.section_title: 连体服加手套，封住手腕
shots.scene: 小研戴上内层手套，手套口盖住袖口
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student puts on inner gloves, pulling the cuffs over the coverall sleeves.
shots.narration: 戴好内层手套，盖住袖口。

shots.section_title: 连体服加手套，封住手腕
shots.scene: 手腕处被一圈胶带封住，放大图
shots.prompt_en: A close-up of the wrist where the glove cuff and sleeve are sealed with a band of tape, with a small pull tab. No people.
shots.narration: 按规程把手腕的缝封住，

shots.section_title: 连体服加手套，封住手腕
shots.scene: 缝隙处小点想钻进去，被挡住
shots.prompt_en: Small dots try to enter the gap at the wrist and are blocked. No people.
shots.narration: 这里最容易成为防护缺口。

shots.scene: 样本管和液体滴落的图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of sample tubes and falling liquid drops. No people.
shots.narration: 今天处理的是体液类液体样本，

shots.scene: 液体溅到连体服上，被挡在外面
shots.prompt_en: Splashed liquid lands on the coverall and beads off without soaking through. No people.
shots.narration: 一旦洒出，连体服能护住全身。

shots.scene: 小研对照墙上空白规程，逐项打勾
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student checks items one by one on a blank procedure poster with icons.
shots.narration: 穿戴顺序写在规程里，

shots.scene: 规程图标旁出现一个文件夹图标
shots.prompt_en: A clipboard icon appears next to the procedure poster. No people.
shots.narration: 照规程做，就是管理控制。

shots.scene: 小研把电池包扣在腰带上
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student fastens a battery pack onto her waist belt.
shots.narration: 送风呼吸器的电池，先挂在腰上。

shots.scene: 小研拿起送风头罩，戴在头上
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student lifts a powered air-purifying respirator hood and places it on her head.
shots.narration: 拉拉链之前，先戴送风头罩。

shots.scene: 小研按下电源开关，头罩里有气流箭头
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student switches on the power; airflow arrows appear inside the hood.
shots.narration: 先开机，

shots.scene: 小研侧耳感受送风，点头
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student feels the airflow inside the hood and nods.
shots.narration: 确认有风送进来，再密封。

shots.scene: 先密封后开机的顺序图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon sequence showing a sealed hood before switching on, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 顺序不能反。

shots.scene: 小研把头罩披肩塞进防护服里
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student tucks the hood's shroud inside the coverall.
shots.narration: 头罩的披肩塞进防护服，

shots.scene: 送风管和电线收进衣服里
shots.prompt_en: The breathing tube and cable are tucked inside the coverall. No people.
shots.narration: 管线也收在里面，不露在外。

shots.scene: 小研拉上拉链，系好颈部
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student zips up the coverall and fastens the neck closure.
shots.narration: 拉好拉链，系紧颈部。

shots.scene: 腰间电池上的三个指示灯
shots.prompt_en: Three indicator lights on the waist battery pack. No people.
shots.narration: 进门前看指示灯。

shots.scene: 三个灯全部变绿，旁边对勾
shots.prompt_en: All three indicator lights turn green, with a check mark beside them. No people.
shots.narration: 灯全亮，才说明供电和送风正常。

shots.scene: 只亮一个灯，红色感叹号
shots.prompt_en: Only one indicator light is on, with a red exclamation mark. No people.
shots.narration: 灯不全，就不要进。

shots.scene: 小研在内层手套外再戴一副手套
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student pulls a second pair of gloves over her inner gloves.
shots.narration: 最后，再戴一层外手套。

shots.scene: 外层手套被溅湿，被脱下丢进废物桶
shots.prompt_en: A splashed outer glove is peeled off and dropped into a biohazard waste bin, while the inner glove stays on.
shots.narration: 外层沾了污染，在实验室里脱掉，

shots.scene: 换上一副新外手套
shots.prompt_en: A fresh pair of outer gloves is pulled on over the inner gloves.
shots.narration: 换上新的，内层一直护着手。

shots.scene: 小研站在镜子前，上下打量
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stands in front of a wall mirror and checks herself from head to toe.
shots.narration: 穿完照镜子，

shots.scene: 头罩、拉链、手腕、鞋套四个对勾
shots.prompt_en: Four check marks over icons of the hood, the zipper, the wrists and the shoe covers. No people.
shots.narration: 头罩、拉链、手腕、脚下，逐一看。

shots.scene: 缓冲间到实验室的门，箭头指向内门
shots.prompt_en: An anteroom with an arrow pointing to the inner laboratory door. No people.
shots.narration: 这些都在缓冲间里穿好，

shots.scene: 小研推开内门走进实验室
shots.prompt_en: Fully dressed, the female graduate student opens the inner door and walks into the laboratory.
shots.narration: 确认无误，才进入实验区。

shots.scene: 阿杰点头，开始取防护服
shots.prompt_en: The young male student nods and takes a coverall from the rack.
shots.narration: 阿杰明白了，也照着规程穿。

shots.scene: 三扇门，旁边各有不同的防护组合图标
shots.prompt_en: Three laboratory doors, each with a different set of protective equipment icons beside it: lab coat and gloves; gown and goggles; coverall and powered hood. No people.
shots.narration: 防护不是越多越好，

shots.scene: 王老师拿着空白评估表对照防护图标
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator compares a blank risk assessment form with protective equipment icons.
shots.narration: 按风险评估和实验室要求来选。

shots.scene: 二级实验室门口：实验服、手套、护目镜
shots.prompt_en: Outside a standard laboratory door: icons of a lab coat, gloves and goggles. No people.
shots.narration: 普通操作，多是实验服、手套和护目镜。

shots.scene: 阿杰自己加减防护被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of someone randomly adding or removing protective items is crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不要自作主张加减。

shots.scene: 电池放在充电座上充电
shots.prompt_en: A battery pack sits on a charging dock with a charging icon. No people.
shots.narration: 送风呼吸器用前要充好电，

shots.scene: 老李更换过滤元件，日历图标
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer replaces a filter cartridge on the blower unit, next to a calendar icon.
shots.narration: 过滤元件按规定更换。

shots.scene: 小研用消毒湿巾擦拭头罩
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wipes the respirator hood with disinfectant wipes.
shots.narration: 用后清洁消毒头罩。

shots.scene: 空白使用记录本，一行行打勾
shots.prompt_en: A blank equipment use logbook with rows of check marks. No people.
shots.narration: 每次使用都要登记。

shots.scene: 阿杰穿好防护，背对小研
shots.prompt_en: The young male student in full protective gear turns his back to the female graduate student.
shots.narration: 镜子看不到背后。

shots.scene: 小研检查他的背部、颈部和手腕
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student checks his back, neck closure and wrists.
shots.narration: 请同伴帮你看背后、颈部和手腕。

shots.scene: 两人互相竖起大拇指
shots.prompt_en: The two of them give each other a thumbs-up.
shots.narration: 互相检查，再一起进门。

shots.scene: 用过的连体服和手套放进生物危害废物袋
shots.prompt_en: Used coveralls and gloves are placed into a biohazard waste bag. No people.
shots.narration: 一次性防护服和手套，

shots.scene: 把脱下的连体服挂回衣架，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of hanging a used coverall back on the rack is crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 用过就丢，不能挂起来再穿。

shots.scene: 废物袋送往高压灭菌器图标
shots.prompt_en: The biohazard waste bag moves along an arrow to an autoclave icon. No people.
shots.narration: 按感染性废物处理。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在穿戴顺序图前
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a sequence of protective equipment icons.
shots.narration: 照规程，一步一步穿。

shots.scene: 头罩、指示灯、双层手套、镜子图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a powered hood, three green lights, double gloves and a mirror. No people.
shots.narration: 先开机后密封，灯亮再进，戴双层手套。

shots.scene: 评估表、充电座、两人互查图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a risk assessment form, a charging dock and two people checking each other. No people.
shots.narration: 按评估选，勤保养，互相查。

shots.scene: 欣欣挥手告别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye in the anteroom.
shots.narration: 穿戴到位，安全进门，再见！
